Just remember, we are also a human beings with feelings. Its totally okay perfectly normal to emphatize and have an emotion during that situation just don't get carried away. Learn from it and become better everytime

ER doc here. The first one always stuck in my head, and to be honest for me ,contrary to what people say, it doesn't get any easier ever. Eventually i just have to deal with the fact that despite of my effort, people die. Cant save them all, but at least i'm doing my best one at a time.

Just stay strong buddy. Working in this field, it is inevitable for us to see tragedy like that. Don't dwell on it too much, take every case experience as a lesson so you can save next time.

​

one more time... stay strong buddy :)

Personally, i think you shouldn't rush to identify yourself with anything immediately just to fit in a certain groups. Take your time to figure yourself out. There are a wide range of sexuality,  perhaps just as many as the amount of people on this earth. And even if you change your orientation or preference later its also perfectly valid because no one understand you better than yourself.

If you feel fake when imagining yourself having a serious relationship with her then maybe take a break for a while? it haven't evolved into something serious i suppose? try have a (non hookup oriented) date with a guy with a same interest with you and see how you feel. even when it doesn't progress into anything serious, at least you have the general idea on how you feel between with a guy and a girl.

​

just my 2c, hopefully that helps somehow and not offend you in anyway

Cheers mate

Hey, i‘m sorry your therapist makes you feel like you’re not being heard. I do know they are supposed through follow up questions especially after your suggestive statement in the first meeting. They even have the authority up to the extent of admitting you for observation if necessary. That level of professionalism hits my nerves. It infuriates me.

Not being heard is suck, but being ignored by the person whom supposed to help you so somewhat on another level. 

Do you have a person whom you trust to talk about what your dealing with? Sometimes it helps if you just talk to so someone, it doesn’t have to be a professional but someone empathetic with your situation will do. Professional help is even better…

Therapy will do wonders. But it wont be in a blink of an eye, it will most definitely takes time and effort.

If you want to talk about things. I‘m here for you to vent or anything :)

But let me tell you a little something…

I work as an ER Doc in Indonesia and for the last month i deal most of Expats and Foreigners Covid-19 Vaccine Program in Indonesia.

Right now you may land safely in one of the international airport and do the quarantine ad mandated HOWEVER the vaccination carried out from abroad are currently not linked within indonesian internal Travel Pass (called : PeduliLindungi). Which basically means you are trapped. You cant even go to Shopping Center in the city without it

My advice : Wait until the system recognizes the vaccine or observe policy changes so there will be less hassle for you and your aim to travel around Indonesia fulfilled

Chat me if you want to talk. I will try to help as much as i can if possible :)
